games.name: Alchemy
games.description: A match-3 merge puzzle about real chemistry. Swap, slide or scroll neighbouring elements into line so they fuse into a higher tier — then into compounds. Climb RnD Centers, react in the lab, and unlock notebook pages for every element and compound: the reaction, where it is used, and how we get it. The chemistry puzzle for grown-ups.

gallery.title: Match 3 Merge
gallery.caption: Shift, match and fuse elements in the lab.

gallery.title: Swap
gallery.caption: Trade neighbouring elements to merge them up the table.

gallery.title: RnD Centers
gallery.caption: Climb the lab map. Each level unlocks a new reaction.

gallery.title: Lab notebook
gallery.caption: Precious metals, rare crystals, salts and more — all in the notes.

gallery.title: Elements
gallery.caption: Craft each element, then read its atomic structure.

gallery.title: Compounds
gallery.caption: See the reaction, real-world uses, and how we make it.

games.name: Memory Path
games.tagline: Watch the path. Walk it from memory.
games.description: A path lights up once. Then it is gone, and you have to walk it from memory — tile by tile, with lives on the line. Four arenas push the same idea further: a glowing tile grid, node graphs across rivers and neon nights, a scout helicopter over the city, and first-person mazes you only saw once.

gallery.title: Tile Arena
gallery.caption: Memorize a glowing path, then walk it tile by tile.

gallery.title: Graph Arena
gallery.caption: Hop between nodes across rivers, towns and neon nights.

gallery.title: Scout Arena
gallery.caption: Fly the scout helicopter and read the city from above.

gallery.title: Maze Arena
gallery.caption: Walk first-person corridors you only saw once.

games.name: Unlock Disk
games.tagline: Slide, swap and scroll colours into place.
games.description: Unlock Disk is a colour-matching puzzle on spinning disks. Slide pieces around a gap, swap neighbouring tiles, or scroll rings and rows until every ring is one colour. Later levels cut famous paintings into the same spinning disks, so you are rebuilding a picture as well as solving a puzzle.

gallery.title: Slide Mode
gallery.caption: Slide pieces round the disk until every ring matches.

gallery.title: Swap Mode
gallery.caption: Trade neighbouring tiles until every ring is one colour.

gallery.title: Scroll Mode
gallery.caption: Spin rings and rows on disks, stacks and cubes.

gallery.title: Picture Puzzles
gallery.caption: Rebuild famous paintings cut into spinning disks.

games.name: WordTrail
games.tagline: Trace the trail before the targets fade.
games.description: Swipe a trail of touching hexes to spell the targets before they fade. Some words are shown as pictures, some are jumbled with the first letter kept, and later modes swap numbers, slide symbols into a gap, or scroll the honeycomb itself. Quick to learn, and the clock is always running.

gallery.title: Picture & Jumble Trails
gallery.caption: Spell what you see, unscramble the rest.

gallery.title: Swap Numbers
gallery.caption: Swap tiles until a line adds up.

gallery.title: Slide Symbols
gallery.caption: Slide tiles into the gap to line up the symbols.

gallery.title: Honeycomb Scroll
gallery.caption: Scroll the honeycomb to spell words.

games.name: Movieyapa
games.tagline: Guess the film. Emoji, charades, scenes.
games.description: Guess the film from emoji plots, dumb-charade clues, jumbled dialogues and ripple scenes. Movieyapa covers Bollywood, Tollywood, Hollywood and Bhojpuri hits, with mix grids and daily events mixed in. Fewer clues means more points — lights, camera, guess.

gallery.title: Every Film Industry
gallery.caption: Bollywood, Tollywood, Hollywood and Bhojpuri hits.

gallery.title: Dumb Charade
gallery.caption: Reveal clues one by one. Fewer clues, more points.

gallery.title: Emoji Puzzles
gallery.caption: Guess the film from the plot or title told in emoji.

gallery.title: Lines, Stories & Scenes
gallery.caption: Unscramble dialogues and test your film memory.

gallery.title: Cinema World
gallery.caption: Mix grids, ripples and daily events. Lights, camera, guess!

games.name: Hidden Mosaic
games.tagline: Find the hidden faces inside the mosaic.
games.description: A picture starts as a grey mosaic of tiny shapes. Drag a magnifier over it to reveal colour, then tap the faces hidden among the tiles — animals tucked into thousands of pieces. Find every face and the whole mosaic bursts into colour.

gallery.title: Magnify the mosaic
gallery.caption: Slide the lens over a grey picture to reveal its colours.

gallery.title: Spot the hidden faces
gallery.caption: Animals hide among thousands of tiny shapes. Tap them all.

gallery.title: Reveal the picture
gallery.caption: Find every face and the whole mosaic bursts into colour.

games.name: Cards & Board Games
games.tagline: Cards, Ludo, Chess, UNO, Trump, Mafia.
games.description: A table of studio card and board games in one place. Play Teen Patti, Bluff, Hearts and 29, race in Ludo, sit down for Chess, match colours in UNO, call trump, or bluff your way through Mafia — solo or with friends.

gallery.title: Card Games
gallery.caption: Teen Patti, Bluff, Hearts, 29 and more, solo or with friends.

gallery.title: Ludo
gallery.caption: Roll, race and capture. Classic Ludo for 2 to 4 players.

gallery.title: Chess
gallery.caption: Play the classic, solo or 2v2 with friends.

gallery.title: UNO + Trump
gallery.caption: Match colours in UNO, call the trump in Trump games.

gallery.title: Mafia
gallery.caption: Bluff, accuse and survive in the party game of deception.
